description: Learned map generator golden map without the additions of op2-codegen-editor 0.12 (all their settings 0): template 'learned', 64x64, seed 3, 2 spawns, quality 1 (fast), any thread count. Hash the tile grid (standard mapping index per cell, row by row) with FNV-1a 64 over each value's 4 little-endian bytes.
